what: Batch 17 B3: age and sex from TAB form records for runners with no history (first starters), candidate path engine/score_v2.py AGESEX_TAB=1 (off)

definitions.age: TAB form age = racing age (birthday 1 August), the same convention as history (Breednet age at the race, plus one for each 1 August crossed since the last run)
definitions.sex: TAB Filly/Mare -> female = 1; Colt/Gelding/Horse -> 0; history uses Breednet sex codes m/f -> 1
definitions.unknown: left missing (contributes zero after race-centring), never guessed

parity_27nov_runners_with_history.note: all 5: served age one higher than TAB (likely name-key collisions or Northern Hemisphere-bred horses); investigate before release

coverage_27nov.note: 3 had TAB starts but no runs in our history (likely overseas or name mismatch)

historical_value.what: Engine v2.3 harness: first starters fitted with age/sex (as in training), judged with them served vs blank (as production serves today)

timing: TAB racecards carry no age or sex (checked 27 Nov); only the per-runner form endpoint does, and step 5b runs after scoring. Live use needs a pre-scoring fetch of form records for runners with no history (about 50 a day).
